import { type TemplateResult } from 'lit';
import type { TextListItem } from '@unofficial-krds/contracts';
import { KrdsElement } from '../base.js';
export declare class TextList extends KrdsElement {
    static properties: {
        items: {
            attribute: boolean;
        };
        ordered: {
            type: BooleanConstructor;
        };
        marker: {
            type: StringConstructor;
        };
    };
    items: readonly TextListItem[];
    ordered: boolean;
    marker: string;
    constructor();
    private list;
    render(): TemplateResult;
}
